verdict.rationale: Ironclad is a general contract platform. Its docs cover building contracts in a no-code builder, launching template-based workflows, e-signature and storage, so hiring paperwork could plausibly run through it. One community user reports using it to send new contractors their paperwork, which is the closest evidence to hiring documents. Nothing in the pack specifically names offer letters, confidentiality/IP agreements or option grants. missing for 10: documented offer-letter templates or workflows, confidentiality/IP assignment agreement support, option grant / equity paperwork support, independent corroboration of employee hiring or equity use cases.
